$comment: SINGLE ORDERED SOURCE OF TRUTH for the freellmapi vendor patches.
This file exists because a patch pipeline that cannot prove its own output
shipped an installer without patch #2. The apply step logged 'already
present - skipping' for BOTH a successful idempotent skip and a genuine
failure, and nothing ever looked at the result, so a patch that was never
attempted was indistinguishable from one that had landed.
ORDER MATTERS. Each patch is authored against the tree with the previous
ones applied and must be applied in this sequence.
MARKERS are the proof. Each is a literal string the patch is supposed to
introduce into a specific file. After applying, the pipeline asserts every
marker is present; the same assertion runs as a unit test against the
checked-in sidecar tree, and at runtime through freellmapi-patches.ts.
Pick markers that ONLY that patch can produce - a platform id it adds, a
migration function it defines, a function it introduces. Never a comment.
TWO SETS, and the second one matters more. `markers` prove the SOURCE was
patched. `builtMarkers` prove the compiled server/dist that actually RUNS
was rebuilt from that source. Source-only proof would accept a tree that
was patched and never rebuilt - green test, wrong relay, which is the same
class of lie as the bug this manifest exists to prevent.
Consumers (keep all three working when this file changes):
scripts/download-sidecars.mjs                                  package-time build
apps/desktop/electron/services/freellmapi-patches.ts           runtime verify
apps/desktop/test/unit/freellmapiPatchMarkers.test.ts          the guard

patches.what: kilo + opencode-zen keyless upstreams, dead upstreams sunk, credential failover, platform-qualified model ids
